snippet.title: Astro Architect - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#citybuilder #basebuilding #gaming #godot 

Astro Architect is an space station city builder where your employees shape your decisions.
As an architect working for the corporation, build your own space station, expand your influence, take care of your employees needs, manage logistics and space expeditions.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291440/Astro_Architect?utm_source=yt_announcement

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/sm7X2wysk5
